hero_claim.headline_en: Revitalize Your Skin with the Power of Collagen, Peptides, and Centella
hero_claim.headline_kr: 콜라겐, 펩타이드, 병풀의 힘으로 피부에 활력을 되찾으세요
hero_claim.subheadline_en: Advanced anti-aging complex for youthful skin.
hero_claim.scientific_basis_en: This complex combines collagen, known for its role in skin structure and elasticity, with EGF peptides that support skin renewal, and Centella Asiatica extract, recognized for its soothing and regenerative properties. Studies highlight the synergistic potential of these ingredients in combating signs of aging and improving skin health (PMID: 42252897, 42343000, 42280293).

supporting_facts_en: Combines high concentration of collagen (29.4%) with potent EGF peptides and Centella Asiatica extract.
Leverages the combined benefits of collagen for structure, peptides for renewal, and Centella for soothing and repair.
Formulated to target multiple signs of aging for comprehensive skin rejuvenation.
